final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS rec_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(rec_count) AS avg_count FROM step1 GROUP BY tradekind), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_count) AS overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT s2.tradekind, s2.avg_count, s2.avg_count - s3.overall_avg AS diff FROM step2 s2 CROSS JOIN step3 s3 WHERE s2.avg_count > s3.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_count) AS avg_col2, AVG(diff) AS avg_col3 FROM step4
